name: Echoes of the End
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #221: Into the Apocalypse Archive

stealth.note: (legendary) to notice the low vibration forming in the area surrounding the apocalypse seed; noticing the apocalypse seed itself has a DC of 0

description: An overwhelming trumpeting fills the area as the apocalypse seed vibrates and shakes off the encrusted bone that's accreted around it to reveal a large tooth fragment from some immense monster.
disable: DC 50 Arcana (master), DC 50 Occultism (legendary), or DC 50 Religion (legendary) to recognize and shore up the area against the localized planar instability causing a connection between the apocalypse seed and Jandelay, or DC 53 Athletics (legendary) to grasp the apocalypse seed and muffle its vibrations with your embrace. Four successes are needed to muffle the aura enough against the planar instability and end the hazard.
reset: The apocalypse seed creates another area of instability after 24 hours.
routine:
(1 action) Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 44 Fortitude Saving Throw save. A creature with the slowed condition from this hazard takes a –2 penalty to this save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (2d10+10) Sonic Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes (4d10+20) Sonic Damage damage and is Slowed 1 until the start of the hazard's next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes (8d10+40) Sonic Damage damage and is Slowed 2 for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Oliphaunt's Echo
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters area C6

Effect Pent-up magical energy from another world begins to release in waves of overwhelming sound. The hazard rolls initiative.
